findings.label: UTR 409 precedes idempotent upsert
findings.detail: On the order-create path the payment_reference uniqueness check returns 409 before the order_id upsert runs, so idempotency on a manual retry depends on the client's timeout-recovery GET catching the already-created order first. The recovery path is correct and covers this; non-blocking. Preserve the GET-before-retry ordering if the recovery logic is revisited.
